Use **Workflows**. The concepts page describes them as: "A Workflow in LlamaIndex is a specific event-driven abstraction that allows you to orchestrate a sequence of steps and LLMs calls." ["llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/getting_started/concepts.md"]

The agent docs also say you can "build your own agentic workflows from scratch" under the "Building Workflows" section, as an alternative to prebuilt agents like `FunctionAgent` ["llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/understanding/agent/index.md"]. The understanding guide notes that workflows can maintain state and can be traced and debugged with integrations such as Arize Phoenix and OpenTelemetry ["llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/understanding/index.md"].

The retrieved excerpts don't include the Workflow API itself (class names, step decorators, or event types), so I can't show code. The workflow documentation section it links to would have those details.
